item.title: Larry Gale Heisey
item.description: Larry Gale Heisey, age 85, a resident of Chillicothe, Missouri, passed away Thursday, December 11, 2025, at his residence. Larry was born the son of Roy and Juanita Ruth (Bullis) Heisey on April 12, 1940, in Kansas. He was a graduate of Springhill High School, Springhill, Kansas. item.description: The Chillicothe Hornets basketball team took on Trenton Friday night, looking for their 2nd win of the season. item.description: Filing for the April Municipal Election continues through December 30th. For the Central Dispatch Board, Kathy Tuttle filed for the West District seat with a 4 year term. That filing takes place the the Livingston County Clerk’s office.
